hero.title: Terms & Conditions
hero.description: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the Engines Market platform. Please read them carefully before using our service.

blocks.text: Engines Market is a trading name of PRESTIGE AUTO ENGINEERING LTD , a private limited company registered in England and Wales.
Unit A5 Windsor Road Commercial Estate, Ramsden Heath, Billericay, United Kingdom, CM11 1QE
We operate solely as an intermediary platform and price comparison service. We do not:

items: Sell, supply, fit, repair, warranty, or store engines or any automotive parts
Handle or process payments between you and any supplier
Act as an agent, partner, employee, or representative of any supplier
Provide any guarantees or warranties on behalf of any supplier
Mediate or arbitrate disputes between you and any supplier

blocks.text: Our only function is to connect you with independent, third-party UK engine suppliers (“Suppliers”) so that you can request and compare quotes. Any contract for the supply of an engine, fitting services, or any other automotive work is made directly between you and the Supplier. We are not a party to that contract.

By using our Platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms, together with our Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy. If you do not agree, you must not use our Platform.

items.title: Our service — what we do and what we do not do

blocks.text: We provide a free price comparison and lead generation service. You submit details about your vehicle and engine problem, and we share that information with our network of vetted UK Suppliers. Suppliers then send you Quotes directly.
3.2 What we do NOT do (explicit exclusions)
To avoid any misunderstanding, we expressly state that we do not:

rows: ✗ No — we are not a garage
✗ No — payment is between you and the Supplier
✗ No — we do not mediate or arbitrate
✗ No — we only apply basic onboarding checks

blocks.text: 3.3 Our “vetted” Supplier network — what it means
We refer to our Supplier network as “vetted”. This term means that before a Supplier can receive enquiries from our Platform, they must pass our commercial onboarding process, which includes:

items: Being a UK-registered business (valid Companies House number or equivalent)
Having a physical UK business address (not a PO Box)
Having at least 12 months of trading history
Having a sustained average public review score of 4.0 stars or higher across platforms such as Google, Trustpilot, and Facebook

blocks.text: Important limitation: This onboarding process is for our own commercial purposes. It does not constitute:

items: A guarantee or warranty of the Supplier's reliability, financial stability, technical competence, or quality of work
A verification that the Supplier complies with all applicable laws (beyond basic company registration)
An assumption of any liability for the Supplier's acts, omissions, or representations

blocks.text: You remain solely responsible for conducting your own due diligence before engaging any Supplier (see Section 5).
Each Supplier operates its own business independently. We have no control over, and disclaim all liability for:

items: The accuracy of any Quote
The quality, safety, legality, or condition of any engine supplied
The standard or timeliness of any fitting or repair work
Any Supplier's compliance with consumer protection laws (including the Consumer Rights Act 2015)
Any Supplier's handling of your personal data (they are independent data controllers)

blocks.text: We do not represent that our Supplier network contains any particular number of Suppliers. References to “a network of vetted suppliers” are descriptive only and do not constitute a contractual promise as to the size or composition of the network.

When you submit an enquiry, we share your details with our Supplier network (subject to the safeguards described in our Privacy Policy, including a cap of 10 Suppliers). Suppliers then send you Quotes directly — typically by email or phone.
We do not generate or verify Quotes ourselves. Quotes are provided solely by Suppliers, and their accuracy, validity periods, and any conditions attached are set by each Supplier alone.

items: You will receive any Quotes (Suppliers may decline to quote for any reason)
Quotes will be received within a particular timeframe (email and SMS delivery is outside our control)
Quotes will be the lowest available in the market

blocks.text: All communication regarding a Quote — including negotiation, specification, warranty, payment, delivery, and fitting arrangements — must be conducted directly between you and the Supplier. We are not a channel for such communications and do not facilitate them.
The validity period of any Quote (if any) is set by the Supplier. We do not extend or enforce validity periods. If a Quote expires, you must submit a new enquiry or contact the Supplier directly.

items.title: Data protection and privacy
items.description: Our collection, use, storage, and sharing of your personal data is governed by our Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy, which form part of these Terms.

blocks.text: In particular, you acknowledge and agree that:

items: We share your personal data with Suppliers (up to a maximum of 10 per enquiry) to provide Quotes — this is the core function of our service.
Suppliers become independent data controllers for the data we share with them. Their use of your data is governed by their own privacy policies, not ours.
We retain your enquiry data for 6 months from your last interaction, after which it is automatically deleted (unless you request earlier erasure, which is free of charge).
You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection under UK GDPR — see our Privacy Policy for details.

blocks.text: If you have any data protection concerns, please contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk .
You warrant that all information you submit via our Platform (including your vehicle registration, mileage, and description of the engine problem) is accurate, complete, and not misleading.
We are not liable for any loss arising from inaccurate information you provide.
5.2 Mandatory due diligence before engaging a Supplier
Before you accept any Quote or enter into any contract with a Supplier, you must take the following steps — and you do so at your own risk:

rows: Check their company registration (Companies House), read their online reviews (Google, Trustpilot, Facebook), and search for any unresolved complaints.
Obtain and read the Supplier's own terms of sale, warranty policy, and any fitting/service terms before you agree to anything.

Confirm in writing (email is best) the full breakdown of costs: engine price, delivery, fitting labour, VAT, and any potential additional charges (e.g., for ancillary parts, unforeseen repairs discovered during fitting).
Request images of the actual engine (if possible), warranty certificates, and any relevant certifications (e.g., BS AU257 for remanufactured engines).
For fitting work, confirm the Supplier has appropriate public liability insurance and a physical workshop address you can visit if needed.

blocks.text: We are not responsible for any loss, damage, or disappointment arising from your failure to conduct adequate due diligence.

You acknowledge that mechanical work (including engine fitting) may reveal additional faults once work has begun. Any additional costs quoted by the Supplier for such unforeseen work are a matter for direct negotiation between you and the Supplier. We have no involvement in, and no liability for, any such additional charges.

All Content on our Platform — including text, graphics, logos, icons, images (including AI-generated visuals), software, and data — is owned by or licensed to PRESTIGE AUTO ENGINEERING LTD. It is protected by copyright, trade mark, and other intellectual property laws of the United Kingdom.

No image on this Platform constitutes a representation of a specific engine or part in stock. If you require an image of the actual engine you intend to purchase, you must request this directly from the Supplier.

items.title: Quick reference
items.description: Key questions and answers regarding our platform and terms:

blocks.question: Do you sell engines?
blocks.answer: No. We are a comparison platform.

blocks.question: Do you handle payments?
blocks.answer: No. Payment is between you and the Supplier.

blocks.question: Do you mediate disputes?
blocks.answer: No. We do not get involved in Supplier disputes.

blocks.question: What do you do?
blocks.answer: We introduce you to vetted Suppliers so you can compare Quotes.

blocks.question: How long do you keep my data?
blocks.answer: 6 months (unless you ask for earlier deletion).

blocks.question: Can I complain about a supplier?
blocks.answer: Yes — we track complaints for monitoring and may remove repeat offenders, but we do not mediate.

items.title: Complaints — our Platform vs Supplier disputes

blocks.text: 9.1 Complaints about our Platform or our service
If you have a complaint about the Engines Market Platform itself (e.g., technical issues, data handling, poor service from our team), please contact us at:

items: Complaints email: complaints@enginesmarket.co.uk
General support: support@enginesmarket.co.uk

blocks.text: We will acknowledge your complaint within 48 hours and aim to provide a full response within 14 working days. Our formal complaints procedure is set out in our Complaints Procedure.
9.2 Supplier disputes — we do NOT mediate
Any dispute between you and a Supplier must be addressed directly with the Supplier. We are not a party to any such dispute, and we will not:

items: Mediate, arbitrate, or participate in negotiations
Demand that a Supplier accept a claim or provide a refund
Provide legal advice or representation

blocks.text: What we may do (limited to monitoring): We do accept complaint information at complaints@enginesmarket.co.uk for the purpose of monitoring Supplier performance. If we receive repeated, substantiated complaints about the same Supplier, or if a Supplier's public review rating falls below 3.5 stars on a sustained basis, we may remove that Supplier from our network. This does not constitute mediation and does not give you any direct remedy against us.

Be vigilant. Only engage with Suppliers using the contact details provided through our Platform or confirmed independently. If you receive any suspicious communication purporting to be from Engines Market or a Supplier (e.g., requests for payment via unusual methods, pressure to pay outside normal channels), report it immediately to support@enginesmarket.co.uk .
